name: Multi Effect Card
description: Interactive image card made of stacked copies that fan out on hover, with switchable clip shapes and toggles for rotation, blur, color, opacity, parallax and a 3D tilt mode with tuning sliders.
contents: Square image card built from stacked layers of one image
Row of four shape buttons (rectangle, circle, diamond, hexagon)
Column of effect toggles and four sliders that appear in 3D mode
behavior: Hover fans the stacked layers out with scale, opacity and rotation stagger
Parallax mode shifts layers with the cursor
3D mode spreads layers in depth and tilts and pans the stack following the mouse
Layout stacks the controls vertically on screens 480px and below
editableByProps: Image, alt text, layer count and card size
Starting clip shape and all button, toggle and slider labels
3D depth, scale, tilt, pan and opacity tuning values

needsCodeEdit.where: duration and ease constants inside the useEffect

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Uses the Space Mono font through next/font/google, so it requires Next.js
Mouse move listener is attached to the document and removed on unmount
Effects are driven by mouse hover, touch devices get only the emulated tap hover
Root has a dotted grid background and white text, so the background prop should stay dark
